description: This file contains controller functions for managing chatflows in a server-side application, including CRUD operations, validation, and access control.

classes.name: ChatFlow
classes.description: Entity class representing a chatflow in the database.

methods.name: checkIfChatflowIsValidForStreaming
methods.description: Validates if a chatflow is suitable for streaming based on its ID.

methods.name: checkIfChatflowIsValidForUploads
methods.description: Validates if a chatflow is suitable for uploads based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteChatflow
methods.description: Deletes a chatflow given its ID, organization, and workspace context.

methods.name: getAllChatflows
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all chatflows, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getChatflowByApiKey
methods.description: Fetches a chatflow using an API key provided in request parameters.

methods.name: getChatflowById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific chatflow by its ID within a workspace.

methods.name: saveChatflow
methods.description: Creates a new chatflow, checking usage limits and associating it with organization and workspace.

methods.name: updateChatflow
methods.description: Updates an existing chatflow, including rate limiting updates.

methods.name: getSinglePublicChatflow
methods.description: Retrieves a public chatflow by ID, with access control based on workspace membership.

methods.name: getSinglePublicChatbotConfig
methods.description: Fetches a public chatbot configuration by ID.

methods.name: checkIfChatflowHasChanged
methods.description: Checks if a chatflow has been modified since a given timestamp.
